    • unloadShop

      void unloadShop(@NotNull @NotNull Shop shop, boolean chunkUnloading)
      Load shop method for loading shop into mapping, so getShops method will can find it. It also effects a lots of feature, make sure load it after create it.
      Parameters:
      world - The world the shop is in
      shop - The shop to load
      chunkUnloading - If unloadShop called caused by chunk unloading, when this is true, QuickShop will try avoid any main-thread opreations to avoid load-unload-load loop
